raw: Agent Name: WebSurfer, Step Number: 6, Reason for Mistake: Misreported the Swedish Royal Court’s 2015 announcement page as saying “Prinsessan Sofia har fött en son,” wrongly implying Princess Sofia was Prince Nicolas’s mother; the correct mother is Princess Madeleine (Duchess of Hälsingland and Gästrikland).
